dialogue.content: こんにちは！そろそろ時間となりますが、始めてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello! It's about time for our session. May we get started?

dialogue.content: こんにちは！相談員です。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: Kaiさん？どうされましたか？
dialogue.English: Kai? Is something the matter?

dialogue.content: つらたん
dialogue.English: It's rough.

dialogue.content: こんにちは！Kaiさん、つらたんとは、辛いのですか？？
dialogue.English: Hello, Kai. When you say “tsuratan,” do you mean you're feeling distressed?

dialogue.content: 学校行きたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないんですね。今、どんな気持ちかな？
dialogue.English: So you don't want to go to school. How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: だるい
dialogue.English: Sluggish.

dialogue.content: 体がだるいんですね。それはしんどいよね。何歳か教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: You're feeling sluggish. That must be tough. Could you tell me how old you are?

dialogue.content: JK1
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year female high school student.

dialogue.content: 高校1年生の女性なんですね。具体的に学校に行きたくないなぁと思うようになったのはいつごろからかな？
dialogue.English: So you're a first-year female high school student. When did you start feeling that you didn't want to go to school?

dialogue.content: 最初から
dialogue.English: From the very beginning.

dialogue.content: 高校の最初からなんですね。そうなんですね。何日かは、学校に行ったのですか？？
dialogue.English: Since the start of high school, I see. Did you go to school for at least a few days?

dialogue.content: うん 何日か
dialogue.English: Yeah, for a few days.

dialogue.content: 何日か通ったんですね。学校でどんなことがあったのか、具体的に教えてもらっていいですか？？
dialogue.English: So you went for a few days. Could you tell me specifically what happened at school?

dialogue.content: 別になんも
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: 学校では特に何もなかったのですね。じゃあ、話変わるけど、家族のこと教えてもらってもいいかな？
dialogue.English: So nothing in particular happened at school. Okay, to change the subject a bit, could you tell me about your family?

dialogue.content: 何を？
dialogue.English: What about them?

dialogue.content: 誰と住んでる？
dialogue.English: Who do you live with?

dialogue.content: 母親
dialogue.English: My mother.

dialogue.content: お母さんとKaiさんと二人暮らし？
dialogue.English: Is it just you and your mother living together?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。Kaiさんは、お母さんのことどんな風に思っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel about your mother, Kai?

dialogue.content: 別に
dialogue.English: Not much of anything.

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。それじゃあ、Kaiさんは、学校に行っていないということだけど、最近どんなことをして過ごしているのかな？
dialogue.English: I understand. Since you're not going to school, how have you been spending your time lately?

dialogue.content: てきとーに
dialogue.English: Just whatever.

dialogue.content: 具体的に教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically?

dialogue.content: ブラブラしてる
dialogue.English: Just hanging around.

dialogue.content: そうかあ。どんなところへ行っているの？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of places do you go?

dialogue.content: 渋谷
dialogue.English: Shibuya.

dialogue.content: 渋谷でどんなことをして過ごすの？
dialogue.English: What do you usually do in Shibuya?

dialogue.content: ネカフェ
dialogue.English: Internet cafes.

dialogue.content: ネカフェかぁ。一日何時間くらいいるの？
dialogue.English: Internet cafes, huh. How many hours a day do you usually spend there?

dialogue.content: ばらばら
dialogue.English: It varies.

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。お母さんは、Kaiさんに対して、何か言ったりする？
dialogue.English: I see. Does your mother say anything to you about this?

dialogue.content: 何も
dialogue.English: Nothing.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。Kaiさんは、中学は学校毎日通ってたの？
dialogue.English: I see. Did you go to school every day in middle school?

dialogue.content: 微妙
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。学校に行きたくない理由って何だろう？？話せる範囲で教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. What do you think is the reason you don't want to go to school? Could you tell me, as much as you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: だるいから
dialogue.English: Because I feel sluggish.

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。Kaiさんが、今日ここにきてくれたのは、どんな思いがあったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. What made you decide to come here today, Kai?

dialogue.content: もう世の中うざくて
dialogue.English: I'm just fed up with the world.

dialogue.content: 世の中がうざいと感じるんだね。どんなことがうざいと感じる？
dialogue.English: You feel the world is annoying. What kinds of things feel that way to you?

dialogue.content: 学校
dialogue.English: School.

dialogue.content: 親
dialogue.English: My mom.

dialogue.content: 学校と母親なんだね。何を言われるのかな？
dialogue.English: So, school and your mother. What does she say to you?

dialogue.content: 何も
dialogue.English: Nothing.

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。何も言われないのに、なぜうざいとかんじるのかなぁ？
dialogue.English: I see. Even though she doesn't say anything, what makes it feel so annoying?

dialogue.content: 感じるでしょ
dialogue.English: Wouldn't anyone feel that way?

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。Kaiさんは、好きなことってある？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you have any hobbies or things you like, Kai?

dialogue.content: は？
dialogue.English: Huh?

dialogue.content: 例えば、ゲームとか漫画とか
dialogue.English: For example, games or manga.

dialogue.content: 別に
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。ここでどんなことを話したいかな？
dialogue.English: I see. What would you like to talk about here?

dialogue.content: なんでこんなつまんないんだろう人生
dialogue.English: Why is life so boring?

dialogue.content: そうかぁ。今、人生つまらないと思っているんだね。思いを言ってくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're feeling that life is boring right now. Thank you for sharing your feelings with me.

dialogue.content: なんでつまらないと思う？？具体的に今まであったことを教えてくれるかな？
dialogue.English: What makes it feel boring? Could you share some specific things that have happened?

dialogue.content: 学校もつまんない
dialogue.English: School is boring too.

dialogue.content: どこもつまんない
dialogue.English: Everywhere is boring.

dialogue.content: 全部つまんない
dialogue.English: Everything is boring.

dialogue.content: そっかあ。全部つまらないかぁ。これからどうしていきたい？学校に通いたい？
dialogue.English: I see, so everything feels boring. What do you want to do from now on? Do you want to go to school?

dialogue.content: 行きたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to.

dialogue.content: 働きたい？
dialogue.English: Would you like to work?

dialogue.content: やだ
dialogue.English: No way.

dialogue.content: 複雑な気持ちだよね。どうしていきたい？
dialogue.English: Your feelings are complicated, aren't they? How would you like things to be?

dialogue.content: わかんね
dialogue.English: I dunno.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。今日、ここで相談してみてどうだったかな？
dialogue.English: That's understandable. How was it for you to talk here today?

dialogue.content: よくわからん
dialogue.English: I don't really know.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ。そろそろお時間となりますが、言っておきたいことあるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Our time is almost up. Is there anything else you'd like to say?

dialogue.content: もういいや
dialogue.English: Never mind.

dialogue.content: 終了ボタン押しますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I'll press the end button now. Thank you.
